notes.title: Demo Announcement and Update.
notes.notes:
Demo Announcement and Update.

Demo is being released on Oct 3!!! I'm really looking forward to getting feedback on what you guys think works, what doesn't and if in general we are going in the right direction for a grey alien game that you guys would like to play.

Working on the full game at the moment which includes abduction and post-abduction, will be sharing progress here in the steam community so if you would like to keep up on the game gimme a follow!

if you notice any errors in the translation, reach out!
